clockAndBoundedWork.wordHelperSourceFact: getWordAtText samples Date.now() immediately before the loop and at the top of every loop iteration; it stops when sampled elapsed wall-clock milliseconds is greater than or equal to the configured 150 ms budget
clockAndBoundedWork.productionClock: MonaWallClock returns integer milliseconds from CLOCK_REALTIME, matching Date.now wall-clock rather than a monotonic or continuous clock
clockAndBoundedWork.testClock: differential fixtures inject and replay the same recorded integer-millisecond sample sequence into Monaco and MonaCode; elapsed-time-dependent result equality is claimed only under that identical clock trace
clockAndBoundedWork.regexpExecution: no custom regexp step counter, deadline or cancellation check is inserted inside synchronous exec, test, match or replace
clockAndBoundedWork.boundaryConsequence: a single regexp execution can exceed 150 ms; the word-helper budget is checked only before the next outer-loop execution, exactly as the pinned source
clockAndBoundedWork.searchRule: ITextModel synchronous find and replace keep no product-specific timeout or step cutoff; asynchronous UI work may discard an unpublished stale snapshot result but may not alter the synchronous matching semantics

chromeProbe.acceptedFlags: d g i m s u v y

stateResults.newRegExpFromExisting: source and flags copied; clone lastIndex is zero while original lastIndex remains unchanged
stateResults.globalStringMatch: ignores the incoming lastIndex and finishes with lastIndex zero
stateResults.stickyNonGlobalStringMatch: starts at incoming lastIndex and retains the success end index
stateResults.globalStickyStringMatch: starts its global collection at zero and resets to zero on failure
stateResults.sequentialGlobalOrStickyTest: success writes the end index and a later failure resets to zero
stateResults.numericToLength: negative and NaN become zero for execution; fractional 1.9 starts at index 1
stateResults.vPatternCloneFailure: [A--B] and [\p{ASCII}--A] compile with v and throw SyntaxError when word-definition cloning drops v and adds g
